Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts: exports ".", "./client", "./src/*", "./locale/*.json"; dsh.client.inject lists shortcuts/locale/ui-layout/ui-settings; platform web.
Per-heading EN/ZH hash record for the README; 16 sections, re-recorded by verify-translation-pairing.
English package reference: the shortcut reference dialog behaviour spec (search, recording, reset-all, focus rules) — the longest single source of truth for the feature.
Chinese mirror of the shortcut README; same 16 sections, same behaviour spec in Chinese.
Inline physical-key recorder: two-overlapping-key chord model, revision-guarded writes, dead-key/IME/AltGraph guards, draft retention on failure.
Localized failure strings for a shortcut write/read failure; names the storage owner (localStorage vs userData/keybindings.json) and the recovery action.
Declares this package's three read-only menu reservations (move/select/dismiss) as fixed shortcut commands with their physical bindings.
Three inline SVG glyphs (edit pencil, error ring, success ring) rendered at 12/16px, aria-hidden.
Plugin apply(): registers the three fixed commands, the settings.general.item row, and the single shell.overlay; inject = ['shortcuts','locale','slots'].
zh/en dictionaries for the 'shortcuts' namespace; zh is the key-set source of truth, en is typed against it.
Stylesheet for the reference dialog and settings row: 42px rows, absolute-positioned rowButton overlay, hairline borders, focus-visible rings.
The reference dialog: coreActionOrder product ordering, subsequence search, toast coalescing, revision-scoped reset-all confirmation, unreadable-config diagnosis.
Root-scoped store for the reference dialog: open/query/focusRequest, with focusRequest as a monotonic counter that drives refocus.
Ambient module declarations for '*.module.css' and '*.css'.
Host loader entry: apply() is a deliberate no-op because keyboard commands execute in the browser half.
Assembly-level spec: desktop defaults stay out of Web, owner unload removes commands, foreground-modal ordering for settings vs shortcuts.
~560-line spec of the recorder: two-key chords, dead keys, four-modifier combos, stale revision, write-failure draft retention, focus retention during a write.
~590-line spec of the dialog: product ordering under reversed registration, search relevance, toast coalescing, reset-all confirmation with stale revision, unreadable-config messaging.
Project references to cordis, shortcuts, locale, store, ui-slots, ui-primitives, ui-renderer, ui-layout, ui-settings; rootDir src.
Build config: clientBundle(import.meta.dirname, ['lib/types/index.js']).
Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots: a single "." export, zero runtime dependencies beyond cordis/react types.
Per-heading EN/ZH hash record for the ui-slots README; 14 sections.
English package reference: the composition model (four slot kinds, Component Factories, five props shares, declaration discipline) and the renderer install contract.
Chinese mirror of the ui-slots README.

1673-line slot registry core + the whole type surface: SlotMap/SlotFactoryMap/LocaleNamespaceMap merges, composed props, SlotCore with load-time validation, shadowing, abdication, one-lifecycle-axis cascade.
React-free installation contract between the slot host and the renderer: SlotRendererHost, StandardSourceBinding, LocaleFace, StaleAuthorizationError, SlotOwnershipError.
Pure re-export of the store contracts (DefineStore, StoreHandle, PropsStore, …) so slot consumers need no second dependency.
Runtime spec of SlotCore: declaration gate, kind semantics, store scope pinning, declaration epochs, version-vs-notification split, reentrant flush.
Spec for the dynamic-key escape hatches (specDynamic, spec) and untouched-key behaviour (frozen empty array, version 0, isLive false).
Compile-time sample set: ~25 @ts-expect-error negatives proving the composed register constraint (children spec, renderSlot key set, store share, inject face, matched drift, factory collisions).
Project references to cordis and the store package; rootDir src, outDir lib/types.
Build config: staticLinked(import.meta.dirname, ['lib/types/index.js']).

Package locale metadata stub; "meta.title" is 界面主题 plus a Chinese description.
Manifest: exports "." / "./client" / "./brand-font.css" / "./locale/*.json"; dsh.client.immediately true; ships lib/styles (fonts + OFL license) in files.
Per-heading EN/ZH hash record for the ui-theme README; 18 sections.
English package reference: theme/font persistence policy, the token sheet inventory, the focus-ring rule, the scrollbar rebinding contract.
Chinese mirror of the ui-theme README, including the per-element elevation-token reasoning.
Pre-plugin bootstrap rows: head CSS colours the canvas before any script, body script installs data-ds-dark-theme plus the three font-size and font-family variables.
Appearance cube row styles: three 180px-basis flex cubes, 0.5px border, selected fill from the module-platform alias.
Light/Dark/System cube row; selection reads the persisted preference from the store, never the click echo.
One rule: the font field is flex 0 1 240px so the three font rows share a basis and align.
Font-family field per role: normalizes and commits on blur or Enter, skips Enter while an IME is composing, resets when the persisted list changes.
One rule: the last visible row of the group drops its bottom separator.
Collapsed-on-open disclosure region holding the three font rows and the two extra size rows; useId gives the controlled region its id.
Stepper pill styles: 36px pill, tabular-nums value, arrow column anchored right and revealed on hover/focus-within via opacity only.
Font-size stepper row; value reads the store mirror, arrows disable at the role's own bounds, optional expander button carries aria-expanded/aria-controls.

ThemeRuntime: preference/font state, immutable snapshots, pending-write adoption guard, token override layers, prefers-color-scheme listening, desktop font-size shortcuts, and the settings-row registration.
zh/en dictionaries for the 'settings.theme' namespace; zh is the key-set source of truth.
Two slot stores mirroring the theme snapshot; both start at revision -1 so the first sync (revision 0) lands as a change.
Mounts the eight global token sheets as plugin-owned <style> tags in dependency order, removed on plugin dispose/HMR.
Ambient module declarations for '*.module.css', '*.css' and '*.css?inline'.
Host half: the volatile Config schema and apply() that pushes boot-theme injections into every index response.
Radius scale, font stacks, settings-card material aliases, and the data-dsh-automatic-focus outline suppression.
Three @font-face rules for the local Montserrat Light/Regular/Medium woff2 files with font-display swap.
Applies superellipse(1.5) corner-shape to every element and pseudo-element strictly inside an @supports guard.
The colour authority: ~90 static palette steps, the full --dsw-alias-* token layer for light and dark, and the macOS-specific near-opaque menu fill.
The :focus-visible fallback naming ring colour and width but never style, plus the pointer-modality suppression rule.
Markdown font ladder derived from the two size variables, the shadow scale, and the per-element elevation tokens with the rebindable stroke colour.
Binary WOFF2 font file (61,548 bytes); header verified as the WOFF2 magic 0x774f4632 ("wOF2") so it is a real font binary, not text — not readable line by line.
Binary WOFF2 font file (62,148 bytes); header verified as the WOFF2 magic 0x774f4632 ("wOF2") so it is a real font binary, not text — not readable line by line.
Binary WOFF2 font file (62,008 bytes); header verified as the WOFF2 magic 0x774f4632 ("wOF2") so it is a real font binary, not text — not readable line by line.
SIL Open Font License 1.1 for the Montserrat family, shipped beside the woff2 files for redistribution.
Onboarding accent, three named gradient stop sets, and light/dark card, checkbox and secondary-action colours.
Scrollbar skin: the --dsh-scrollbar-* rebindable indirections, the @supports not selector(::-webkit-scrollbar) split, and the WebKit pseudo-element geometry.
Shiki syntax-highlight token palette for light and dark, with the background aliased to the markdown code-block token.
Durable theme schema: the three font roles with their own ranges, the ThemeSettings zod envelope, and the font-family normalizer.
Window drag-region ownership spec: exactly two drag declarations in the tree, a pinned chrome-row manifest, and a markup scan for stray data-window-drag marks.
Spec for the Appearance row: the three cubes, aria-pressed, and that selection follows the store mirror rather than the click echo.
Spec for the plugin wiring: slot registration before or after the declaration, snapshot projection into the row store, one-mutation font stepping, and HMR collapse recovery.
Spec for the bootstrap rows: head CSS content, body script execution, system resolution, and that a font list cannot smuggle a "</script>" into the page.
Spec that the brand font ships offline: WOFF2 magic bytes, the three weights, the OFL text, and the package export/files entries.
Spec that the eight global sheets mount in dependency order and are removed on plugin dispose.
Host-side spec: the durable namespace validates and disposes with its fiber, and every index response carries the current preference, sizes and font lists.
Corner-shape contract: the token and its universal application live only inside the @supports guard, and every full-round radius pairs corner-shape: round.
Elevation contract: stroke colour default on body only, derived tokens per element, no neutral border beside an elevation shadow, and every neutral solid border at 0.5px.
Exact allowlist of the 12 component stylesheets permitted local radii, with the offending selector and value spelled out.
Ring contract: focus rules may only use the three ring tokens, pointer suppression must pair with the modality publisher, and no box-shadow is cleared.
Behavioural spec of the automatic-focus outline suppression: borders and shadows survive, keyboard navigation restores the outline, IME input stays outline-free.
Spec for the font row: persisted value shown, blur/Enter commit the normalized list, Enter ignored while composing, and the normalizer's escaping/idempotence rules.
Spec for the disclosure group: starts collapsed, aria-controls resolves, three fields appear, and each row routes its write to its own role.
Spec for the stepper: value display, arrow clicks, outward arrow disabled at each bound, and the display following the store mirror.
Menu material ownership spec using the TypeScript compiler API: no role=menu/listbox outside MenuSurface and no local material overrides.
Radius contract: local finite radii and misspelled radius tokens are rejected across every client stylesheet, against an exact exception allowlist.
Scrollbar contract: token set parity between palettes, every token consumed, the standard/pseudo-element split, and the palette-derived elevated-surface rebind check.
Spec for the two row stores: init shape with revision -1, sync semantics, and the revision guard dropping stale and duplicate writes.
Shared CSS contract helpers: a rule flattener, an at-rule block locator, a var() reference extractor, and a package-wide stylesheet enumerator.
Spec for ThemeRuntime: boot-script seeding, range and fraction rejection, pending-write convergence, token override stacking, and prefers-color-scheme following.
Browser-half project config; excludes src/index.ts and references the renderer, slots, settings, shortcuts, store and host webserver projects.
Host-half project config listing only src/boot-theme.ts, src/index.ts and src/theme-settings.ts as files.
Solution file referencing the host and client projects, with no files of its own.
Build config: clientBundle plus a copy step shipping brand-font.css, the three woff2 files and the OFL text into lib/styles.
